sections: A quieter way to be consideredfor the right work.
Built for people who don’t need another job board.
Fewer roles. Higher signal.Considered work for considered people.
The other side of the network.
textBlocks: TaaSFlow Network is a curated space for highly skilled people — senior operators, specialists and internationally mobile talent. Express interest in selective briefs, or stay privately discoverable for premium opportunities worldwide.
Membership is free for professionals. Your profile is never visible to clients without your consent.

TaaSFlow Network is most useful if you’re a senior operator, a deep specialist, or a professional considering an international move. The members we work best with already have options — they want fewer, better conversations.
Open to relocation in selected markets
You decide how visible you want to be — and to whom.
Review the brief, then express interest. We review every submission individually and reply with a clear next step.
Create a member profile to be considered for future briefs that match your direction. No public listings, no algorithmic noise.
Opt in to be surfaced — privately — to selected subscription clients for premium opportunities. Always under your control.

Traditional job boards optimise for volume. We optimise for relevance. Every brief on the network has a real client behind it, a real budget, and a real timeline — and every member is reviewed by a person, not a filter.
Discretion is part of the product. Your profile is never indexed publicly, never sold, and never shown to a client without your consent for that specific brief.
Your profile is invisible to search engines. Members only.
We ask before sharing your details with any specific client.
Pause visibility, edit details, or leave the network at any time.
Hide your profile from named companies you don’t want to see it.

Many of our briefs are remote-first or open to international candidates. Where relocation or visa support is on the table, the brief will say so explicitly — and the client commits to it before we make the introduction.
Most briefs are open to professionals across multiple regions.
Focus on EMEA, APAC and the Americas — local context matters.
Visa and relocation support is brief-specific. Never assumed, never promised on our behalf.

TaaSFlow works with subscription clients — funded scale-ups, global enterprises, and specialist firms — who pay to access a curated network rather than scroll through CVs. When you opt in to be discoverable, you’re shown only to those clients, only for briefs that match your direction, and only with your consent at the moment of introduction.
Review live briefs and express interest in the ones that fit. We reply individually.
Join the network privately. We’ll only be in touch when something genuinely fits.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

headings.text: Open a role across time zones.

sections: Open a role across time zones.
textBlocks: Remote-first sourcing across EMEA, the Americas and APAC. Relocation and visa support are offered per brief, only when the employer has confirmed the scope in writing.
Coverage means active sourcing, screening and time-zone alignment — not country checklists.
Active sourcing across the UK, EU-27, EFTA and select MENA markets. Local time-zone screening and language filters.
North America, LATAM and Caribbean coverage with time-zone-aligned pipelines for cross-region teams.
Established reach across Australia, New Zealand, India, Singapore and Southeast Asia. Explicit local-hours filters.
Remote-first is the default working model on most briefs.
Time-zone constraints are captured at intake and enforced in scoring.
Hybrid and on-site briefs state the required city or region up front.
Working preference is a candidate-owned field — filters, not assumptions.
Structured multi-channel sourcing per brief, not blanket outreach.
Role-specific rubrics adapt to regional titles, credentials and market norms.
Language proficiency captured as a first-class attribute where the brief requires it.
Every candidate is reviewed by a human before introduction.
Relocation and visa support are brief-specific. They appear on the job details only when the client has confirmed it in writing.
If a role offers relocation, the type of support (bonus, agency, sponsorship) is stated on the job page — never implied by us.
Candidates share work authorisation and relocation openness during intake, so mismatches never reach the shortlist.
We do not publish country totals or visa outcomes. Every brief states what the employer commits to, and nothing more.
Employer of record is the client. Introductions include eligibility and location.
Fixed-term contracts where the client already has the entity or contractor framework in place.
Where an EOR is required, we introduce with the client's chosen partner — we don't act as the employer of record ourselves.
Structured intake captures region, remote scope and any relocation commitment before sourcing starts.
A live recruiting workspace with ranked, evidence-backed candidate delivery.

links.text: New: transparent role-specific scoring — see how it works.
